actual_scope: Findings of Nov 15 following #7606/#7607/#7609 (no kappa, no word): (1) DYINGPAIR theorem: no dying role pair or single in the rho = 2 two-arm caller under counts T1/T2 (Floor matrix nonsingular without nesting, triangular recursion with Q_a eigenvalues 1 +- sqrt(t/(1+t)) != 2); (2) SLACK: interval-capped line pricing correction, extended Crossing Lemma, lone extra roles closed, rank drop forces b_K > 0 on both sides; (3) GAPLEMMA: Delta-Floor lemma kills every pair and k = 0 layout (102 of 117), proved ceiling +1.15% for the 15 single-role layouts, standalone open question; (4) native laws on the #7615/#7617 words: RELAY-DIAMOND, lattice lock, dim-8 non-nesting tails law, JOINT-SUPPLY / FRAME-FANOUT / ROUTE-DEMAND-IS-UNIT-LEVEL; (5) exact single-main reroute bound and forced D, helper-layer lower bound 944 / 1,366 and zero-need relay census, D ledger by bucket; (6) spec ledger: SPEC vs verifier clauses, new public registers legal with one-hop helpers free in kappa, the fresh-register meet-twice (Sandwich) rule, S = 2*(104*16 - 17*56), mains S-neutral.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a constructive helper-basis or causal-split improvement. This package records theorems, scoped laws and bounds on P104 (no kappa claim, no word) so that others can see which caller layouts, native edits and contract relaxations are closed or bounded, and why.
bottleneck_link: The P104 invoice's fixed costs (the caller header and per-port odd unit, the owned decoder mass, the native helper layer's 9,962 D0 per call) are what every proposed redesign has hit; this package proves where the caller part is closed (DYINGPAIR, SLACK, GAPLEMMA), bounds the native part (lock laws, helper floor, mains bound) and records which contract clauses are SPEC.
stop_rule: Every proved claim has a proof in PROOF.md or a stated argument; every finite fact tagged [C] is re-run by a checker with controls; lane-only numbers are tagged [C-lane] or [C-param]; open items stated as open; validator PASS.

open_questions.question: Does a root of the non-dying layout L' (B plus one surviving extra role, one stage shorter) have a first-two-stage prefix in the set reachable by the dying family-A left arm (codimension about 7)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It decides whether the single-role dying layouts exist (proved ceiling +1.15%) or the caller closes at <= +0.97%.
open_questions.first_step: Build an exact L' root with the exact-root pipeline, compute its prefix family dimension and test transversality against the reachable set.

open_questions.why_it_matters: Any rank drop across a death needs b_K > 0 on both sides, so nesting would close the slack class.
open_questions.first_step: Exact two-arm search with one dying role at stage 2, extending the DYINGPAIR recursion.
